tags.feature: Version is now visible on the credits screen
Small slowdown now happens when a boss part is destroyed
Points are now awarded for destroying a boss part (500)

tags.balance_change: Boss part health has been decreased for missile canisters (0.15 -> 0.12) and arms (0.25 -> 0.2)
Points awarded for killing the boss has been reduced (4000 -> 3000)
Boss laser has been increased in power so much that enemies and missiles are now hit by it
Big Bullet upgrade spawning odds have been increased (0.01 -> 0.02)

tags.feature: WASD will now work for selecting menu items

tags.bug: Escape will no longer pause the game after losing

tags.feature: "Ass" is now an acceptable leaderboard name (sorry)

notes.title: Demo update v0.9.1
notes.content:
The demo has been updated to version 0.9.1, complete with bugfixes for known issues and tiny reworks. Contents follow:

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tooltips in the options menu now clarify that mouse left-click and right-click also fire your main weapon and mortar, respectively.
[/list]
[b]Changed:[/b]
[list]
[*] The game now defaults to 1280x720 resolution on first launch, and initializes at that size.
[*] Attempting to unpause while the options menu is open now closes the menu instead of unpausing.
[*] The SFX channel is now side-chained to the UI channel so power-up and extra life sounds are more audible.
[*] The tank's closebox is much larger to show off the feature more (try a controller!).
[*] Several sound effects have been reduced in volume.
[*] Reworked boss animations for the spiral shot and missiles.
[*] Boss missiles in phase 3 no longer fire infinitely (that was a bug).
[*] Increased player corpse health from 10 -> 15.
[*] Turrets should no longer spawn on top of each other.
[/list]
[b]Removed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Cleaned my dust filter.
[/list]
